nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus, or Shorten as HMPV is a respiratory virus affecting all age groups Commonly attributed to symptoms like 
a)Cough
b)Difficulty in breathing 
C)Fever.
d)Congestion

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text: Commonly mistaken as cold this Virus can advance to stages like pneumonia or even bronchitis when not looked upon earlier.

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text: Its an airborne transmitter and cases where you come into contact with someone who is infected, either by cough or sneezes touching contaminated surfaces leads to its spreading.

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Now the Fun part Combating this Mf.
Here are steps on how you would keep yourself safe from it.

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Washing of Hands Frequently ✋ 
Clean hands reduces chances of You picking up virus when you come into contact with surfaces https://t.co/SxAlr90Oz3

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Using hand sanitary 
Either Wipes or Towels Alcohol has capabilites to fight the virus habitise having sanitisers around you.

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Wear a mask 
In crowd places during this period priotise wearing masks or even if you caring for someone whose sick. https://t.co/kCPWttCGs7

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Boosting Your immunity.
Having a strong immunity helps you in deterring any sickness. This you achieve through eating a balanced diet, having proper sleep schedule (atleast 6hours a night), hydrate yourself and regular exercises. https://t.co/JxuXQcRcuf

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Practise Respiratory etiquette.
Cover your mouth, when coughing and sneezing. When you use a tissue plan to dispose it accordingly.

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Avoid close contacts. 
During this period limit your hugs and handshakes especially if the person is showing symptoms of flu.

nodes.author: Sydney_Yendysss
nodes.text:
Update your vaccination cabinet.
Whilst HMpv still doesn't have a vaccine, you can reduce cases of other respiratory risks like flu by vaccinating yourself against it.
